::: page-shell

<h1 id="about-page-heading">About Design For Impact</h1>

<p class="lede">Design For Impact is a collaborative scaffold for helping statistical practitioners and domain experts align on purpose, connect analytical choices to stakeholder needs, and communicate evidence in ways that support action.</p>

<p class="about-opening">The project was created by Jett Palmer through graduate research in statistics at California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo. It responds to a practical challenge in statistical collaboration: technically sound analysis does not create impact automatically. Impact also requires alignment, intentionality, and translation.</p>

:::

</section>

<section class="about-section" aria-labelledby="development-heading">

::: page-shell

<h2 id="development-heading">Developed through research and iteration.</h2>

<div class="about-copy">
<p>Design For Impact began as an exploration of how statistical collaborators could plan for and evaluate impact more explicitly. The process model and artifact were refined through feedback from statistics students and practitioners working in academia and industry. Their experiences helped clarify the tool’s benefits, limitations, component definitions, and implementation guidance.</p>

<p>The current version is intended to be flexible. It can serve as a shared project document, supplement an existing collaborative workflow, or provide a mental model for practitioners who already use similar habits informally.</p>
</div>

:::

</section>

<section class="about-section about-creator-section" aria-labelledby="creator-heading">

::: page-shell

<h2 id="creator-heading">About the creator</h2>

<div class="about-copy">
<p>Jett Palmer is a statistics researcher and consultant whose work focuses on statistical collaboration, organizational problem solving, and translating evidence into action. He created Design For Impact as part of his graduate research at Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo.</p>

<a class="text-action" href="https://jettpalmer.github.io">Visit Jett’s website [→]{aria-hidden="true"}</a>
</div>

:::
